benefit_text: The scheme pays 20000 rupees as lump sum assistance on death of the breadwinner. The money is for the surviving head of the household found after local inquiry.
who_can_apply: The applicant must be a citizen of India. The family must live Below Poverty Line. The deceased breadwinner was more than 18 years and less than 60 years and the applicant is the succeeding primary breadwinner.
documents: The important papers are death certificate and BPL card. Proof of identity and bank account details are also needed.
how_to_apply: The form is available free at the District Social Welfare Officer or Tehsil Social Welfare Officer. The filled form with documents is submitted to the designated officer.
